chunks: Will he whose breast has been opened up to Islam be (like one) in luminescence from his Lord? Alas for those whose hearts have been hardened to God's remembrance! They wander in clear error.

key_terms.لِّلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ: for those whose hearts are hardened

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the heart of a believer and a disbeliever according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Tawassul' and the spiritual receptivity granted by the Ahl al-Bayt, who serve as the means through which God expands the hearts of believers. The contrast between the 'expanded heart' and the 'hardened heart' underscores the necessity of inner purification to receive divine light, a theme central to Shia asceticism and gnosis.
